posts.content:
Another great visibility hack for your SaaS is to get listed on the Hermes Agent marketplace (DR 84). You get a dedicated page and a dofollow link.

Massive shoutout to @aarondelasy for finding this.

Here is how:

1. Have a remote MCP server for your SaaS (ask Claude to build it for you).
2. Make a public GitHub repo with a plugin.json, an mcp.json and a skill for your MCP.
3. Open a PR to NousResearch/hermes-agent that adds one file, plugin-catalog/yourname.yaml, pinned to your commit.
4. Wait for the merge. Ours took less than a day.

A few notes:

Install your plugin in Hermes yourself and post the test results on the PR, reviewers look for it.

Once it's merged, anyone can install it with hermes plugins directly.
posts.author: Taras
posts.notes: 在 Hermes Agent marketplace 拥有 remote MCP server，制作含 plugin.json/mcp.json/skill 的公共 GitHub repo，向 NousResearch/hermes-agent 开 PR 添加 plugin-catalog yaml 并等待 merge，得到 DR84 dofollow 专用页外链。

comments.author: Marvin
comments.text: 合并后还要打开公开页面核对链接和安装入口。PR 合并、目录展示、真实用户能安装，是三个不同的检查点。
